title: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after
question:
What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Communication number refers to phone number.

prediction.sql: SELECT s.XCL_047 AS school_name, AVG(sat.XCL_039) AS average_writing_score, s.XCL_058 AS communication_number FROM schools AS "s" JOIN satscores AS "sat" ON "s".XCL_041 = "sat".XCL_030 WHERE (NOT s.XCL_061 IS NULL AND s.XCL_061 > '1991-12-31') OR (NOT s.XCL_062 IS NULL AND s.XCL_062 < '2000-01-01') GROUP BY s.XCL_041, s.XCL_047, s.XCL_058

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    AVG(sat.XCL_039) AS average_writing_score,
    s.XCL_058 AS communication_number
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat
  ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE
    (s.XCL_061 IS NOT NULL AND s.XCL_061 > '1991-12-31')
    OR (s.XCL_062 IS NOT NULL AND s.XCL_062 < '2000-01-01')
GROUP BY
    s.XCL_041,
    s.XCL_047,
    s.XCL_058
